      "reason": "两层住宅需要明确每层的空间范围和层高才能生成建筑楼层实体。",
      "blocking": true,
      "evidence_refs": ["schema:bim-json-v2:representation"],
      "source_turns": ["turn-user-001"]

    },

      "id": "mf-window-details",
      "code": "WINDOW_DETAILS_MISSING",
      "path": "/known_facts/windows",
      "message": "窗的数量和宿主位置尚未确定。",
      "reason": "用户提供了窗尺寸但未说明数量和所在墙面。",
      "blocking": true,
      "evidence_refs": ["schema:bim-json-v2:entity", "capability:IFC2X3:IfcWindow"],
      "source_turns": ["turn-user-013"]
    }
  ],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "unsupported_requests": [],
  "user_corrections": [],
  "clarification_questions": [],

    "source_turns": ["turn-user-001", "turn-user-005", "turn-user-009", "turn-user-013"],
    "selected_evidence_ids": [

      "capability:IFC2X3:IfcStair",
      "capability:IFC2X3:IfcBuildingStorey"
    ],
    "few_shot_ids": []
  }
}
